session_log: Day 1 S1: First principles architecture — SISO+JAA canonical, 142/142 tests
Day 1 S2: Axiom audit — §5.2 bridge registration, §2.2 ledger persistence, §8.3 SISO
Day 1 S3: Idearium completion — spec.build, ESS gap engine, pipeline, kernels panel
Day 1 S4: Contracts + integration tests — 74 tests, /api/register, /api/recall
Day 1 S5: Watchdog + indicators — live dots, spawn crash fixed, nexus> watchdog
Day 2 S1: Diagnostic sequencer — cli/diagnose.js, NEXUS-SPEC.md living spec
Day 2 S6: Gated boot sequences — lib/boot-sequence.js, every system HARD/SOFT gates, orchestrator starts systems one by one, auto-diagnose on HALT
Day 2 S7: Guardian HTTP/WSS decoupled — HTTP boots standalone, WSS is SOFT phase. ensureCert() throws not exits. diagnose knows HARD vs SOFT with auto-install. All wss.on deferred via onWss().

Day 2 S8: Replaced ws/WebSocket with NCP (lib/ncp.js) — SSE+fetch, zero deps. Added lib/heartbeat.js (Bridge OS immune system), lib/node-ledger.js (UNKNOWN→CANDIDATE→MEMBER→SUSPENDED→DEAD trust state machine). Orchestrator now uses HeartbeatManager + PulseListener :7777 UDP. Every system announces itself via UDP pulse. No hardcoded registration. No TLS required for userscripts.

Day 2 S9: Ledgers as learning system. lib/event-ledger.js — every bus.emit across all systems writes to event_log.jsonl before routing. Baseline learning (avgInterval, consistency per event type). Anomaly detection via sigma deviation. Invariant scanner (co-occurrence, failure precursors). Four pipeline gaps fixed: guardian writes agent_calls to cortex, emerge compile results logged to orchestrator, job.complete writes to cortex memory, RAID hook in cortex event handler.

Day 2 S3 (session 3): SEAM pipeline. guardian/lib/seam-queue.js — state machine QUEUED→VERIFIED, 3 retry strategies (context/shorter/forensic), §LAW II throughout. guardian/lib/spec-parser.js — .spec → prerequisite block + chunks with SEAM contracts. guardian/userscript-chatgpt.js — v8.3 full UI on NCP transport, ChatGPT DOM selectors. guardian/server.js — /command with SEAM queue dispatch, spec parsing, artifact file output to data/output/{date}/{jobId}/. Fixed jaa.query→jaa.all throughout. 68/68 pipeline tests.

Day 3 S4 (session 4, this session): Pill fixed (WebSocket remnant removed, connState strings corrected). Cortex context pull before job dispatch. ?CORTEX: post-response command parser. _log syncs err/gap/job/ok to server event-ledger. Forge duplicate tabs removed, Brain SEAM panel shows live queues, Queue SEAM button added. nexus-chat-v4.html NCP edition. /version auto-update endpoint. diagnose.js adds seam-queue, spec-parser, detector, NCP, version, SEAM live checks. 142/142 kernel, 68/68 pipeline.

Session test (Dusk PA continued): SEAM 1 — lib/ess.js (ESS kernel: hash store, callto, resolve, unresolve, binding log). lib/ico.js (ICO pipe: axioms, SNR+delta+sigma, compartment, invariant, ledger, crystal). 47 data folders. SEAM 2 — ESS wired into RAID (content-addressed dispatch, UNRESOLVE→gap). SEAM 3 — lib/queue.js (physical file queue: uuid.pending.md, crash replay, tags, conversation log). SEAM 4 — lib/baseline.js (per-kernel baseline: sigma deviation→gap, failure mode ledger with friction). All wired into guardian. diagnose.js baseline friction checks. 142/142 kernel, 61/61 pipeline.
